My research focuses on Distributed Machine Learning (DML) and Federated Learning (FL). Soon I will include an introduction to this topic in the [Teaching section $\rightarrow$](../teaching).


## Dissertation

### Representatives Learning for Distributed Support Vector Machines

The primary focus of this dissertation is modifying the standard SVM optimization problem to allow for stronger representatives (or pseudo data points) to be shared between nodes
in DML. Further work should investigate applications of this research to SVMs involved in deep learning architectures.

[View Dissertation (PDF)](files/dissertation.pdf)
